title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Faranma-faranma k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di
bridge: Sipaniladenw, i ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don falan falanw ye: ‘i sira ma’ ka falan’, ‘i ka kan b’a falan’ anw ka i ka subjonkti ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don. Angalendenw, i ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don falan falanw ye: i ka modali verbw (may, might, could) ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don, i ka adverbi degree (highly, somewhat, arguably) k’a k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don, k’a i ka impersonal opinion strukturw (It is worth noting). I ka sira ma’ ka falanw ye i ka ‘must’ don falan falanw ka i ka ‘debe ser’ ye, nka, angalendenw, ‘must’ ka falan falanw sira amana ka dedukow ka falan. I ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don falan falanw ye i ka ‘I would argue’ don falan falanw ka ‘I think definitely’ ye.
rule: Ma no k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don angale C1 la, o k’o don: 1) Modali verbw ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don: ‘must’ (amana ka sira), ‘may/might/could’ (ka sira ma’ ka falan), ‘can’t’ (ka sira ma’ ka falan). 2) Adverbi degree: ‘highly’, ‘extremely’, ‘somewhat’, ‘arguably’, ‘undoubtedly’. 3) Impersonal strukturw: ‘It is worth noting that...’, ‘It could be argued that...’, ‘The evidence suggests...’. 4) Opinion verbw: ‘I would argue’, ‘I contend’, ‘I maintain’ (i ka ‘I think’ ye). 5) Kontrast konektow: ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’, ‘whereas’. O falan falanw ka ‘I think’ don akademisi ka k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don; o k’o don ‘This implies that...’ anw ka ‘It could be inferred that...’. Ma no k’oyiraliw k’a cogo di don, o k’o don ‘strengths and weaknesses’, ‘implications’, ‘limitations’.

title: Irony and Understatement / Ironi, sarasismu, n'a yiridonkolo
bridge: A taali gi, ironinw b'a sarasismunw ka kanw ye a maaya ka ton daa liilalo kelenkelenw koo (màana, «claro», «por supuesto», «como no»), n'i diminutifi koo n'i augmentatifinw yaara be se ka diiman. A anglesigi, ironinw b'a yiridonkolonw ka diiman ye a maaya ka ton daa liilalo kelenkelenw koo, n'a yiridonkolonw bena culture la ka tugu banna ka taa laala ka sira tugu fenninw ye. Faa la ka taa laala: a anglesigi, yiridonkolonw bena ironinw ye ka taa laala (màana, «not bad» ka diiman «excellent»), n'a hispanohablantes ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala. Nka, faaru: sarasismunw a anglesigi ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala.
rule: A anglesigi C1 la, ironinw b'a yiridonkolonw ka diiman ye: 1) Yiridonkolonw: adjectifi koo adverbe diimanw ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala (màana, «It's not the worst idea» = «es una idea muy buena»; «a bit» koo «slightly» ka taa laala ka taa laala). 2) Sarasismu: ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala (màana, «Oh, great!», «Well, that's just perfect» koo «I love it when...»). 3) Yiridonkolo: ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala (màana, «passed away» ka diiman «died», «let go» ka diiman «fired», «between jobs» ka diiman «unemployed», «full-figured» ka diiman «fat»). Diimanw ye: adverbe diimanw («hardly», «barely», «scarcely») ka yiridonkolonw; ka taa laala ka taa laala («Is that so?») ka ironinw; ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala. Alaajiya: contextenw kulu se ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala; a formalizenw, sarasismunw ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala. Yiridonkolonw ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala: a profesionalizenw, i ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala. A hispanohablantes la: ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala (i ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala), n'i ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala ka taa laala.

title: Indirect Speech Acts and Implicature / Fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana
bridge: A taali gi, fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'N ka tugu la kɛra ye?' ka di a ye fana. Anw fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'I was wondering if you could pass me the salt.' Anw fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'N ka tugu la kɛra ye?' ka di a ye fana. Hispanophones bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'N ka tugu la kɛra ye?' ka di a ye fana. Anw fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'I was wondering if you could pass me the salt.'
rule: Anw fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 1) 'Can/could/would you...' ka di a ye fana (Could you close the window?), 2) 'I was wondering if...' ka di a ye fana (I was wondering if you could help me), 3) Fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'Don't you think it's too late?' ka di a ye fana, 4) 'It might be a good idea to...' ka di a ye fana. Fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko: 'I'm cold' ka di a ye fana. C1 ra, a na a ma fɔlɔɲɛsɛɲu kɛ yɛrɛ la ka jamana bɛɛ kanu ana afɔlɔ kanu ana sira n'a faamu ko.

title: Structuring Formal Presentations / Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw
bridge: Sɛgɛsɛgɛ la, an ka kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw kɔrɔtan fana ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘kelen ye’, ‘u fana’ an ka ‘kɔfale bɔ’ an bɛɛ kan. A maa Angalɛkan, kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘firstly’, ‘furthermore’, ‘but more importantly’, an ka ‘in light of this’ bɛɛ kan. Kɔrɔtan fana bɛɛ minw be se ‘por un lado’ ka ‘on one side’ kan sɔrɔ, tuma ‘on the one hand’ kan. An ka ‘in conclusion’ bɔra ‘to sum up’ an ka ‘ultimately’ ye. Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka dumancɛn fana ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ, an ka cɛnɛminw ka tɔgɔ fana ka dumancɛn bɛɛ ye.
rule: Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw (C1) ra, an ka kɔrɔtan fana ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘I would like to begin by...’, ‘Let me start by...’, an ka ‘The purpose of this presentation is to...’ bɛɛ kan. Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘Firstly’, ‘Secondly’, ‘Furthermore’, ‘Moreover’, ‘In addition’ bɛɛ kan. Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘However’, ‘On the other hand’, ‘Nevertheless’ bɛɛ kan. Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘Indeed’, ‘In fact’, ‘It is important to note that’ bɛɛ kan. Kɔfale bɔ yɔrɔ cɛnɛminw ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘In conclusion’, ‘To summarize’, ‘In light of the evidence’ bɛɛ kan. An ka kɔrɔtan fana ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘it's’ tuma ‘it is’ kan. An ka kɔrɔtan fana ka kanbɛlɛnw bɛɛ minw be se ‘we’ tuma ‘we can see that...’ kan.

title: Hedging and Boosting in Academic Writing / Kɛmɛkɛla dɔɲɛniw kanbɔlɔfilila jɛnɲɔgɔnya la
bridge: Sɛgɛsɛgɛ kan, espanee-jaɲɔgɔn be sɔrɔ u ka subjunctivo bɛɛ, ‘quizás’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) dɔn ‘posiblemente’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) jamana bɛ mɛnnin kɛlɛ, nka, akadɛmikikan angɛlɛkan la, hedging ka jamana tɛ bɛ verb modal, probability adverb bɛɛ, opinion verb wala ‘suggest’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) dɔn ‘appear’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) jamana bɛ mɛnnin kɛlɛ. Kala jɔna ‘es posible que’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) ‘it is possible that’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) jamana na bɛ mɛnnin kɛlɛ, o tɛ bɛrɛw la, o tɛ ka jamana bɛrɛw koo ‘may’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) dɔn ‘could’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) jamana na. O bɛɛ, ma sira kɛlɛ ma hedging tɛ bɛ yɔrɔnin kɛ: akadɛmikikan angɛlɛkan la, i kɛlɛ i ka jamana bɛrɛw sira, i bɛɛ, i kɛlɛ i ka jamana bɛrɛw saba taara.
rule: Akadɛmikikan angɛlɛkan la, i kɛlɛ hedging (kɛmɛkɛla dɔɲɛniw) jamana bɛ mɛnnin kɛlɛ ma i kɛlɛ i ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ nin kɛlɛ. I ka jɔn bɛɛ: 1) Verb modal: may, might, could (p.ej., 'This may indicate...'), 2) Adverb frequency/probability: often, sometimes, possibly, presumably (p.ej., 'This possibly suggests...'), 3) Opinion verb: suggest, appear, seem (p.ej., 'The data suggest that...'), 4) Impersonal expression: it could be argued that, there is evidence to suggest. Boosting (kanbɔlɔfilila) jamana na, i kɛlɛ adverb wala ‘clearly’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ), ‘undoubtedly’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ), ‘definitively’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ), nka, verb wala ‘prove’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ), ‘demonstrate’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ). I tɛ bɛrɛw la, ma sira kɛlɛ ma i kɛlɛ boosting tɛ bɛ hedging tɛ jamana na: ‘This clearly may be true’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) fɔlɔ la tɛ bɛrɛw la, jɔn laban bɛɛ la. O bɛɛ, akadɛmikikan angɛlɛkan la, i tɛ bɛrɛw la i kɛlɛ ‘I’ (sɔrɔnin tɛ) personal pronoun tɛ jamana na fɔlɔw kan, i kɛlɛ passive structure dɔn impersonal structure jamana na.

Ma sira kɛlɛ ma i kɛlɛ i ka tɔgɔ tɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka kɛlɛya k'a filɛ (may, might, could) dɔn i ka tɔgɔ tɛ fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka kɛlɛya k'a filɛ (clearly, undoubtedly, demonstrates). title: Advanced Negotiation Strategies / Sitatigiya dɔgɔkun koɲumanw
bridge: A taali giin na, kɔfɛ ka sɔrɔla kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu, an ka taa ka di a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di. A fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ a ka kɛlɛya kanu dɔw la ka di.
rule: Kɔfɛ ka sɔrɔla kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu C1 la, kɛlɛya kanu sitatigiya wɔsɔndɔw bɛɛ ma fɔlɔw: 1) Kondisɔnaali bɛɛ (kɔlɔsi, kɔlɔsi fali, kɔlɔsi sani) ka tɛmɛ hipotetik laasɔndɔw bɛɛ ma: 'If we were to extend the deadline, we would need a discount'. 2) Verbo modali bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ kɛlɛya kanu kɔrɔtɔlɔɔw bɛɛ ma: 'I would suggest', 'We could consider', 'I might be open to'. 3) Frasi konseʃɔn bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ reformulasɔn 'although', 'however', 'while' ka tɛmɛ flɛksibiliteew bɛɛ ma aw ka tɔgɔtɔrɔ filɛ. 4) Idiomatik frasi bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ komprɔmi frasi bɛɛ ma: 'meet you halfway', 'a win-win situation', 'bottom line'. 5) Kondisɔnaali 'unless', 'provided that', 'as long as' ka tɛmɛ fɔmulɛ kondisɔnaali bɛɛ ma: 'We can agree, provided that you cover shipping costs'. 6) Kɛlɛya kanu kɔrɔtɔlɔɔw bɛɛ ma: 'I was wondering if you would consider a different payment schedule'. Kɔrɔtɔlɔ: 'I want' taa lɔn bɛɛ ma; 'I would like' aw 'We are looking for' bɛɛ ma. Eksɛpsɔn: kɛlɛya kanu fɔlɔw la (hard negotiation) la, a ka tɛmɛ dɔgɔkun kɛlɛya kanu, nka kɔrɔtɔlɔ bɛɛ yɛrɛ.

title: Pragmatic Styles in Cross-Cultural Communication / Sitɔgɔ nyɛsigi kanbɔlɔfɛnw kanu
bridge: A taali gi, kulisa la kɛ kɔfɛ la kɔrɔmani bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ. A lɔnnikɛbɔyiraw kanu, sisanaw kɔrɔmani bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ. Hispani kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ, manti lɔnnikɛbɔyiraw kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ. Trap: 'maybe' o b'a 'quizás' mɔnɔn o bɛɛ 'baje el tono'; 'I think' a lɔnnikɛbɔyiraw kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ 'creo' a taali gi.
rule: A lɔnnikɛbɔyiraw kanu, kulisa la kɛ kɔfɛ la kɔrɔmani bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ: 1) Hedges ('sort of', 'kind of', 'I'd say'), 2) Verbos modales en pasado (would, could, might) para distanciar la aserción, 3) Preguntas negativas o etiquetas ('couldn't we...?'), 4) Fórmulas de cortesía con 'I'm afraid', 'I'd rather'. A taali gi, kulisa la kɛ kɔfɛ la kɔrɔmani bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ. A lɔnnikɛbɔyiraw kanu, 'I see your point, but...' bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ, manti a taali gi 'no estoy de acuerdo' bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ. C1 sira, 'just' la 'actually' bɛɛ se ka kanu bɛɛ kanu kɛ ka jɔsa kanu kɛ ka kɛlɛya kanu kɛ kulisa la kɛ kɔfɛ la kɔrɔmani bɛɛ.
